title: NNDC wallet cards 2023: 14C half-life 5686 y
summary: The October 2023 wallet-card row for 14C prints half-life 5686 y (year), uncertainty 22.
body: The October 2023 Nuclear Wallet Cards row for 14C prints half-life 5686 y (year). The uncertainty integer after the unit is 22. The decay-mode text before the gamma-ray energies is: β−. The booklet's half-life note says the value is followed by the unit (s: second, m: minute, h: hour, d: day, y: year) and that the uncertainty follows the unit and is given in italics. Superscripts in powers of ten were read from the smaller glyphs in the PDF. Italics were not a separate character. The uncertainty is the integer in that position. The booklet says all nuclides with T1/2 longer than 1 hour are included. This is an evaluated half-life from that compilation, not a new counting experiment.  The IAEA Live Chart string is on world.physics.14c-half-life and is not the same printed value. Both are evaluations. This card does not pick a half-life by averaging them and does not convert units.
